description: Chain fold, `X.then(a)`: throwing if X or `a` is. Handlers are ordinary functions, so a throwing one colors the link over a clean head.

diagnostics.message: Awaiting `resolves().then(dirty)` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the body producing it was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
